text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has arrived, and the Japan
Dirt
Derby is just around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the campsite, Wonder Acute is
flanked by two
younger students.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Good luck in your next race, Acute!
We're rooting
for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume on the left is Hokko
Tarumae, a
local idol from Tomakomai,
Hokkaido. She races
to put her
hometown on the map.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And on the right is Copano Rickey. She's
in the
year after Hokko Tarumae, and
runs with the
power of feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why, thank you. It's very reassuring
knowing I
have you two in my corner.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to train for the Japan
Dirt Derby
with me?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! I mean, I'd love to, but I can't
hold a
candle to you! I haven't even
debuted yet...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If it's too much for Tarumae, then I've
got no
chance. I'm nowhere near
prepared for something
like this!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. Then, I suppose partner running is out of the question. Sigh... Training by myself can get awfully lonely, though...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I can't run with you, but there's something I can do for you as an idol.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Singing! I'll sing for you, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And I'll focus on feng shui as I watch
you! Once I
figure out your lucky
direction, victory is
guaranteed! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much!
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll bake some cookies for you in return.
That way,
we'll be even.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about that! We're here to support you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their conversation warms my heart. With
support
from these younger runners,
Wonder Acute is sure
to train harder
than ever.
